The [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Farstine]] was '''occupied''' by the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. The [[Parent/Legends|parents]] of a [[Unidentified child (Farstine)|child]] were [[Death/Legends|killed]] by Imperial [[Soldier/Legends|soldiers]] during the occupation, leaving the [[Gender/Legends|boy]] an orphan.<ref name="RPG" />
